tldr: Nemotron 3.5 launched in October with day-0 vLLM support for Super VL, added speech with Transcribe, and picked up an AWS EKS guide by Oct 29. In November AWS put Super VL into SageMaker JumpStart, and two arXiv papers followed: a 4GB small model for conversational agents and an RL post-training study on Super.
whats_new: NVIDIA released three synthetic training datasets, a fine-tuning recipe and a DFlash speculator for faster inference for Nemotron 3.5 Parse, its document-parsing model, on Nov 26.
why_it_matters: Nemotron 3.5 is turning from one hosted model into a family you can fine-tune and serve yourself, from a 4GB agent model to a 120B multimodal model, each with open data or recipes.

status.detail: Super VL is one-click on SageMaker JumpStart; the family now includes a small agent model and a Parse model with open datasets and a speculator.

beats.headline: Super VL lands in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
beats.summary: AWS offers the 120B vision-language model in NVFP4 and BF16 variants for text, image and video inference.

beats.headline: Papers on a 4GB agent model and RL on Super
beats.summary: Bolt E4B 4GB is post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it for fast conversational agents; a second paper runs RL on Super with five expert-built task sets.

beats.headline: Nemotron 3.5 Parse ships open data, a fine-tuning recipe and a DFlash speculator
beats.summary: The Hugging Face post also explains Parse's two-phase training.

open_questions: Do independent benchmarks confirm the gaps OrcaRouter reported against DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp?
How much does the DFlash speculator speed up Parse, and does vLLM support it?
Are the Bolt E4B 4GB weights downloadable, and under what license, given its Gemma base?
Does the RL recipe on expert-built tasks ship as a released Super checkpoint?
take_for_builders: If you parse PDFs or scans in a RAG pipeline, fine-tune Parse on your own documents with the released recipe and measure the DFlash speculator's latency before swapping out your current parser.

day_captions.1cff1239c8922e03: Adds a managed AWS path: JumpStart deployment of Super VL in NVFP4 or BF16, beyond the earlier EKS guide.
day_captions.15de4f547fb7e7f3: Extends the family down to a 4GB small model aimed at fast conversational agents, built on Gemma-4-E4B-it.
day_captions.012976eaf8c36d5e: Research on what RL with expert-built tasks, including real-world software engineering, adds to Super (120B total, 12B active).
day_captions.3d2697b636d74b83: First open-data release in the thread: three synthetic datasets, a fine-tuning recipe and a speculator for the Parse model.
